reviewed_by: Codex source/instruction review plus independent read-only critic /root/fov_evidence_review
review_scope: Valid Windows x86 model/resource/mesh pointer chains

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Same exact entry and straight-line leaf body in live BN MCP, REA/Ghidra, and Radare2 listings.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail reads model from [ESP+4]; signed count is returned in EAX.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: x86 static assertions enforce +0x0C/+0x0C pointer chain and mesh+0x7E count field.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retained original instruction listings have no calls and no caller-visible memory stores. Runtime fixtures compare EAX; they do not claim a dynamic memory-write trace.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: 14 exact original-vs-compiled-x86 comparisons; both executions must reach the synthetic return sentinel.

limitations: ESIL emulation of original retail instructions and a freshly compiled i686 candidate, not live game execution.
Invalid pointers, out-of-array C++ arithmetic, non-x86 record layouts, and scene/factory integration are outside this accessor verification.
